# Judson Parker

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

## Personality

Judson Parker is a jovial, smooth-spoken, and good-natured man, though he surprisingly has few friends. He holds a reputation for being very sharp while lacking in principle.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042)_

## History

During an Avonsea [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) initiative, Judson Parker planned to rent his farm fence to a patent-medicine company for advertisements, smoothly refusing a visit from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) when they tried to persuade him otherwise. Shortly after, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) caught him accepting a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) near the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters). Fearful that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) would expose his corruption and destroy his reputation, Judson agreed to drop the fence advertisements in exchange for her silence.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P18](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0018), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P58](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0058), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), +1 more_
